editorial:
You walk into a family reunion that goes wrong fast. The Davison family gathers at a remote house for a wedding anniversary, and old arguments bubble up before dinner. Then masked killers attack from outside, turning a tense meal into chaos. But one guest, Erin, surprises everyone with survival skills and a calm head. It is bloody, tense, and darkly funny, with a home invasion setup that keeps twisting. The family bickering makes the danger feel personal, and you never quite know who will make it out.

The action is quick and brutal, with clever traps and nasty surprises. Sharni Vinson shines as Erin, giving the movie a strong, likable hero. The family drama adds humor and bite, though some kills feel predictable and the middle slows a little. It is great for horror fans who like smart final girls and messy family tension. For the best picture, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Erin fights back and kills most of the attackers. She learns the killers were hired by her boyfriend Crispian and his brother Felix to inherit family money. Crispian tries to play innocent, but Erin sees through him. She kills him too. A cop arrives, but Erin accidentally kills him with a trap. She survives, bloodied, as police sirens close in. The twist is that the sweet guest was the deadliest person in the house.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves smart final girls and messy family tension.
